headline: Dalal Street Prepares for Muhurat Trading to Kick-Off Samvat 2083 amid Strong Market Momentum

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Indian equities defied global gloom and posted their best week in six years leading up to Diwali.
Foreign Institutional Investors stepped up buying as Nifty bulls reclaimed the 25,000 mark.
Strong global cues and domestic buying momentum drove Sensex past the 81,000 mark.
Oil price movements and FPI flows are expected to keep Indian equities volatile in Samvat 2083.
whatHappening: NSE and BSE are conducting a special one-hour Muhurat Trading session today to kick-start Samvat 2083.
Trading for the Muhurat session is scheduled to commence at 2:20 PM.
Sensex recently rallied over 1,700 points to cross 81,000 during pre-Diwali sessions.
Market participants and veterans are looking ahead to opportunities and trends in Samvat 2083.
summary: Indian stock exchanges are conducting the special Muhurat Trading session today to usher in Samvat 2083. Markets enter the new Hindu calendar year on a robust note after posting their best weekly performance in six years. Factors such as FPI flows, global market cues, and crude oil prices are expected to guide market direction in the coming year.
